description:
BW11 global version smartwatch with SIM card support is made for people who want calls on the wrist—even when the phone isn’t nearby. Insert a SIM and use it like a standalone calling smartwatch for quick check-ins, work follow-ups, or travel days when you don’t want to carry your phone in hand. The bright HD touchscreen keeps menus, contacts, and alerts easy to view, while the ultra low power design helps stretch battery life for everyday wear.

It also covers the daily basics: step, distance, and calorie tracking to keep you moving, plus music control for convenient playback from your phone. A built-in camera lets you grab quick snapshots in the moment. With a clean black finish and adjustable silicone strap, BW11 fits office wear, casual days, and workouts—while staying compatible with both Android and iOS for Bluetooth features.
